title: Alina Settles was 5-years-old when her mother allegedly abducted her from Henderson, Nevada in 2015
text:
2 hours ago Alina Settles. Photo by NCMEC website. Forty-one missing children in Nevada, spanning from 1975 to 2026, were reported to and listed with the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC). Alina Settles is one of them. She's been missing from Henderson, Nevada (Clark County), since July 23, 2013.
About Alina was only 5 years old when she disappeared. She would be 18 now. She was allegedly abducted by her non-custodial mother, Elena Settles (pictured below). On February 4, 2015, a felony warrant for kidnapping was issued for her.
Both may have traveled to Russia, and Alina may be using the alias "Shainyan" as her last name.
Elena Settles. Photo by NCMEC website. Physical description Alina was 3'3" tall and weighed 45 pounds when she went missing. She had brown hair and brown eyes.
Details There are very few details about Alina's case. She is listed in the National Missing and Unidentified Persons System (NamUs), case #MP28752 , an official website of the U.S. Department of Justice.
Alina's case remains active. If you have any information regarding Alina’s disappearance or whereabouts, please reach out to the Nevada Office of the Attorney General at 1-702-486-3420, and information this office receives may be kept confidential.
You can also contact the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) through its website at https://www.missingkids.org or its 24/7 call center at 1-800-843-5678, and reference NCMEC #1237765.
Thank you for your time to read and share. Find Alina.
